description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(mcp,ci,evals): harden MCP diff gate, off-Vertex PR scan, and evals

Harden the MCP regression gate, concurrency/subprocess lifecycle, and
advise.py target-root resolution; gate Cloud Monitoring daily token
checks on Vertex models, add --max-run-seconds + SIGTERM summary flush
and --scan-mode uncovered for CI; ensure POSIX /bin/dash compatibility
and MANTIS_INVOCATION_DIR anchoring in run.sh/install.sh; and wire
production before_model_callback parity and symmetric equivalence-class
dedup scoring in the eval harness.

Change-Id: I68d049f373e5f547cf0ddda858af478f4f65364a
